description: Full-text search across SEC filings since 2001 (EDGAR FTS). Supports quoted phrases ("share repurchase"), boolean OR, and filters for form types, date range and company CIKs. Returns matching filings with company, form, filing date, 8-K items and a document URL. Default range: last 365 days.

ciks.description: Only filings by these company CIKs (use resolve_company to get a CIK from a ticker).

forms.description: Only these form types, e.g. ["8-K"] or ["10-K","10-Q"].

offset.description: Result offset for paging (EDGAR returns pages of 100). Default 0.

query.description: Search text. Use double quotes for exact phrases, e.g. "going concern".

start_date.description: Earliest filing date. Default 365 days ago (YYYY-MM-DD).

name: search_filings
title: EDGAR full-text search
